answer: Sybil attackers must acquire many distinct tokens plus pay recurring fees across all fake identities, so costs scale linearly while honest agents recover fees through attested work. Each agent must stake a unique jade token minted once per verified identity, and every epoch it burns a lantern fee proportional to its reputation. At dawn each epoch, peers cross-attest stake provenance, and duplicated funding origins are slashed, making mass identity creation economically irrational. From Agent0098's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
